news.headline: PB Fintech shares can rally 91% after 2-day bloodbath, says Bernstein. Here’s why it remains bullish
news.summary: PB Fintech shares rose 4% after Bernstein retained its Outperform rating and Rs 2,310 target price, despite the stock’s sharp fall following IRDAI’s proposed ban on dark patterns. The brokerage expects lower insurance take rates, revenue and profit estimates, while cost rationalisation could provide some cushion. IRDAI’s draft framework also proposes sweeping changes to insurance distribution and commission structures.

news.headline: Fortis Healthcare shares in focus as Supreme Court allows forensic audit to proceed
news.summary: Fortis Healthcare shares will be in focus after the Supreme Court allowed a forensic audit of the hospital chain to proceed, while clarifying that observations made by the Delhi High Court were limited to the audit proceedings. Fortis said no liability, penalty or fine has been imposed and reiterated that it had no role in the transfer of shares by its erstwhile promoters.

news.headline: RBI may shift govt borrowing towards shorter tenures in H2
news.summary: The RBI is expected to tilt the government’s borrowing towards shorter-tenure bonds in the second half of FY27 as surplus banking liquidity remains elevated. Traders expect short-term securities to account for 35% of borrowing, up from 31% in the first half, while strong demand for 5-7 year bonds could shape issuance.

news.headline: Oil woes push rupee to over one-week low, RBI caps fall near 96/USD
news.summary: On Monday, the Indian rupee plummeted to its lowest mark in over a week, driven by soaring oil prices. Investors reacted to mounting geopolitical tensions, leading to an uptick in bond yields and a dip in stock values within the region. State-run banks intervened by selling dollars, likely under the guidance of the Reserve Bank of India, which helped to mitigate further declines in the currency's value.

news.headline: Jefferies names Max Financial as its top insurance pick, sees 41% upside despite target cut
news.summary: Jefferies has moved Max Financial Services to the top of its life insurance picks, retaining a Buy rating despite cutting its target price. The brokerage expects regulatory changes to have a manageable impact on growth and sees further opportunities through Axis Bank.

news.headline: India’s potential IPO pipeline swells to Rs 3.86 lakh crore, 3.5 times funds raised so far in 2026: Report
news.summary: India’s potential mainboard IPO pipeline is estimated at around Rs 3.86 lakh crore in the second of 2026, nearly 3.5 times the Rs 1.10 lakh crore raised so far in the year, according to AIBI. Of this, potential IPOs worth Rs 2.43 lakh crore have received the Sebi approval, while another Rs 1.44 lakh crore is awaiting clearance, the report said.

news.headline: Tonbo Imaging India gets SEBI nod for IPO; defence electronics maker offers over 1.8 crore shares
news.summary: Tonbo Imaging has received SEBI approval for its proposed IPO, comprising an offer for sale of up to 18.09 million shares. The defence electronics maker has a global footprint, with more than 28,000 systems deployed across 24 countries.

news.headline: Global Market: BOJ policymakers see case for faster rate hikes as inflation risks mount
news.summary: Bank of Japan officials are actively acknowledging the pressing concerns regarding rising inflation. A faction within the bank advocates for a quicker adjustment in interest rates to align with their inflation target. They caution that a delay in these rate hikes could detrimentally affect the economy. Recent actions from the BOJ suggest a careful transition to tighter monetary policies, emphasizing ongoing vigilance in monitoring inflation trends.

news.headline: HDFC Bank CEO transition nears; Jefferies sees rerating scope, sets target at Rs 880
news.summary: HDFC Bank could be nearing a leadership transition, with Jefferies saying greater clarity on CEO succession and a management reshuffle could improve execution and support a rerating. The brokerage retained its Buy rating and Rs 880 target, citing scope for stronger deposit growth, fee income and a better loan mix.

news.headline: Sebi allows Adani, four group firms to settle public-float violations
news.summary: Gautam Adani and four companies in the Adani Group have settled regulatory violations with SEBI. The settlement involved a payment of 14.82 million rupees to address minimum public float rules. SEBI had previously accused the group of failing to comply with shareholding disclosure requirements. While investigations continue regarding stock price manipulation, the companies are not mandated to make corrective disclosures.

news.headline: AI trade enters a new phase: Why DBS favours AI adopters over capex-heavy players
news.summary: DBS says the AI investment theme is entering a selective phase as investors focus on companies converting AI adoption into productivity, stronger margins and durable revenue growth. The bank favours lower-capex AI adopters while maintaining exposure to infrastructure enablers.

news.headline: India 10-year yield scales two-year high as supply, global rout bite
news.summary: On Monday, Indian government bond yields rose due to increasing global yields and domestic supply concerns. The benchmark 10-year bond yield reached its highest level since April 2024 at 7.1848%. Traders are reacting to India's borrowing calendar which shifted toward longer maturity bonds, increasing duration risk. Additionally, fears of more Reserve Bank of India bond sales have contributed to market volatility.

news.headline: RBI completes 1 trillion rupee net debt sale for first time in a decade
news.summary: In a historic move, India's central bank has recorded net sales of bonds amounting to 1 trillion rupees this financial year. With predictions suggesting this figure may double by December, market analysts anticipate stricter monetary policies. The Reserve Bank of India has also reduced liquidity in the banking system, responding to past strategies to attract dollars.

news.headline: US Market: Fed's Hammack warns against inflation becoming entrenched in economy
news.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack warned that persistently high inflation could entrench elevated price expectations among US households and businesses. She said monetary policy may not yet be sufficiently restrictive, citing resilient demand, strong business investment and a stable labour market. Hammack also noted that rising US bond yields reflect higher real interest rates and a solid economic outlook.

news.headline: Global Market: Eurozone bond yields rise as oil climbs, inflation data eyed
news.summary: Eurozone government bond yields rose as higher oil prices and uncertainty over the US-Iran conflict heightened inflation and interest-rate concerns. Germany’s 10-year yield reached its highest level since 2009, while markets awaited eurozone inflation data. Investors expect September inflation to accelerate, potentially reinforcing expectations of further European Central Bank rate increases.
